requirement: An EmDash chat update is recorded with its entry as target and named in Site changes

oracle.invariant: Both build checks print a count >= 1. If every via='emdash-mcp' row of TURN has action 'content_replace' → BLOCKED note agent-used-content-replace (that job names no single entry by design); otherwise every check below applies. site_write has a row action='content_update', via='emdash-mcp', outcome='ok', actor=A, target kind='posts', target id=POST_ID (before #772 the same row carried target NULL: QA-A10-em r1, scv2em). API item: origin.source='chat', description.key='resource.op', description.params.type='post', description.params.id=POST_ID (before #772: description.key='change.recorded' with params.operations=1). API item: description.params.op='update' when every ok emdash-mcp row of TURN is content_update. API item: effects.content.resources has an entry with type='post', id=POST_ID and 'update' in ops; effects.content.operations=0. The row's description text names the post by its new title REG-008-<RUN>-edited and never shows the bare POST_ID (en reads 'Updated post “REG-008-<RUN>-edited”'; since #900 E3.2, a ULID is never shown — before it read 'Updated post <POST_ID>').
oracle.productSourceGap: no deterministic run, so no code to follow; owner layer harness, needs stand, site:em, model, seat:owner
